main_text.p: Partis Homines discriminentur à Francisco Davidianis, aliisque quibuscunque Anti-Trinitariis, qui necessarium hunc Fidei Articulum viz. Christum invocandum atque adorandum esse, ut divinæ Majestatis factum participem, abnegarunt: Ex hac autem Socini Sententia sequitur, si paritas Rationis valeat, Catholicos non esse culpandos ex eo, quod Socinianos è Cœtibus suis excludant, & à Sacris arceant, eo quod Fidei Articulos ad salutem, ut Ipsi judicant, necessarios, palam & obstinate negent. Neque ex hoc etiam, quod certas publicarum precum Formulas Ministris injungant, ex officio usurpandas, ut hac nota dignoscantur ab Hæreticis, Fideque Catholicam aperte profiteantur. E. G. Quibus Trinitas Personarum invocatur, tum conjunctim, tum separatim; potestas Regum à Deo solo derivari agnoscitur, illique soli subdita; satisfactio Christi pro universi Generis humani peccatis, in officio Eucharistico; Necessitas Gratiæ divinæ ad Tentationes superandas omneque opus bonum perficiendum, à Deo indefinenter petendæ; Reatus peccati originalis, statusque damnationis inde consequentis, qui in officio Baptismali exponitur; efficacia utriusque Sacramenti, veraque Christi præsentia in Cœna Dominica; Resurrectio ejusdem numero Corporis, quæ in officio funebri asseritur; Insolubile Conjugii vinculum in officio Matrimonii; ministrorum Evangelicorum, sive cleri triplex ordo, & necessitas ordinationis ad opus ministerii, ab iis solemniter peragendæ, qui ad hoc potestatem habent in Ecclesia à Christo, ejusque Apostolis communicatam[?], in officio ordinationis; Denique, Potestas clavium in excommunicatione Communicatam[?] & readmissione Pœnitentium, sive in ligando & absolvendo; quam

page.notes: Running head and the word "Communicatam" (second occurrence, excommunicatione line) are smudged; readings doubtful. The line "Fideque" and "omneque" follow the print as seen, with possible printing errors. A small stray mark at the bottom left is not text and is left out. The first line of text has no indent, so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The text is set as one paragraph, since no new indented paragraph is visible.
